title: Practice 3: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Do you confirm or do you deny it?
exercises.why: **подтверждать → подтверждаете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я ___ (перемалывать) свой кофе вручную с помощью кофемолки с рукоятью.
exercises.prompt: I grind my coffee by hand with a coffee grinder with a crank handle.
exercises.why: **перемалывать → перемалываю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Фортуна ___ (улыбаться) тому, кого не замечает Фемида.
exercises.prompt: Luck smiles upon those whom Justice lets slip.
exercises.why: **улыбаться → улыбается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I suppose anything's possible.
exercises.why: **полагать → Полагаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Does Mr Ito teach history?
exercises.why: **преподавать → преподаёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Как вы с женой ___ (распределять) обязанности по дому?
exercises.prompt: How do you and your wife divide chores around the house?
exercises.why: **распределять → распределяете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why do academics have a double life?
exercises.why: **вести → ведут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Caffeine is addictive.
exercises.why: **вызывать → вызывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I don't trust these surveys.
exercises.why: **доверять → доверяю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Жаль, что никто здесь не ___ (изучать) белорусский.
exercises.prompt: It's a pity no one here studies Belarusian.
exercises.why: **изучать → изучает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He thinks of everything in terms of money.
exercises.why: **измерять → измеряет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Do you understand Slovak?
exercises.why: **понимать → понимаешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Two of a trade seldom agree.
exercises.why: **соглашаться → соглашаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Sami's dog poops everywhere.
exercises.why: **какать → какает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She's training to be a car mechanic.
exercises.why: **учиться → учится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том с Мэри ___ (цапаться) весь день напролёт.
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary bicker all day long.
exercises.why: **цапаться → цапаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I beg your pardon, madam.
exercises.why: **просить → Прошу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Rats breed rapidly.
exercises.why: **размножаться → размножаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It's starting to get hot in here.
exercises.why: **становиться → становится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Reheated pasta is never any good.
exercises.why: **бывать → бывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
